COAG

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows marked hypoxemia, mild anemia, leukopenia with neutropenia and lymphopenia, mild thrombocytopenia, and elevated inflammatory markers (CRP, mild monocytosis, eosinophilia, basophilia). Liver enzymes are mildly abnormal (ALT↑, AST↓), and INR is elevated. These findings suggest acute systemic inflammation or infection (possibly viral), with impaired oxygenation and mild hepatic involvement. Immediate clinical correlation and further evaluation are recommended.
